id.description: Execution Log ID used together with Job ID to retrieve this run.

jobId.description: Job ID discovered from the Job list.

result.description: Run result: completed, completedWithWarnings, faulted, or null while no outcome is available.

message.description: Summary message for this execution, or null when unavailable.

finished.description: Execution finish timestamp, or null when unfinished.

executionTimeSeconds.description: Execution duration in seconds, or null when unfinished.

messages.description: Available history messages in chronological order. Empty history does not prove that no messages were originally recorded.
